answer: An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Because a fabricated citation fails the haven check immediately, the ivory audit keeps the resolved set and the pigment replay shows exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 228 aliases hence pays the reading cost 228 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
